amazing-grace-wels-portland-or.assessment: Amazing Grace Lutheran Church (WELS) Portland is a confessional Lutheran congregation in the greater Portland metro led by Rev. Joe Johnson. WELS posture in the highly progressive Portland metro represents a distinct confessional Lutheran witness. Solid recommendation for a man in Portland or surrounding suburbs seeking confessional Lutheran preaching, full subscription to the Book of Concord, and male pastoral ministry.

score_notes.leadership: WELS congregational polity under synodical oversight.
score_notes.cultural: Greater Portland context — confessional Lutheran posture distinct from progressive metro drift.
score_notes.denominational: WELS — confessional Lutheran with full synodical accountability.

score_notes.christology: ARP affirms Nicene orthodoxy — Christ fully God and fully man, sole mediator.
score_notes.scripture: Westminster Standards affirmed — Scripture inerrant, infallible, sufficient.

score_notes.soteriology: Historic evangelical gospel of grace through faith alone.
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT vocabulary visible; operates 'New Beginnings' food pantry as community expression.

amia-grace-anglican-fairhope-al.assessment: Grace Anglican Church in Fairhope, Alabama, pastored by Rev. Scott Davis, is a parish of the Anglican Mission in the Americas (AMiA), a three-stream Anglican missionary society. AMiA was the first and largest body to depart The Episcopal Church in the early 2000s under the oversight of the Province of Rwanda.

score_notes.soteriology: Reformation Anglican soteriology per the 39 Articles.

score_notes.mission: AMiA is structurally a missionary society — mission is its raison d'être.

amia-new-hope-mission-st-peters-mo.assessment: New Hope Mission is a specialized AMiA chaplaincy-style ministry in St. Peters, Missouri under Rev. Wayne Wimbish. The church is a weekly gathering of approximately 45 nursing home residents — its stated mission is "taking the church to seniors who can't otherwise get out to come to the church." Unusual ecclesiology (no fixed parish facility) but a creative response to overlooked elder demographic. AMiA conservative Anglican.
